listingTitle: Compile constant Python regexes outside loops
title: Compile constant Python regexes outside loops
why: Calling re.compile for every iteration repeats pattern lookup or compilation and obscures the reusable matcher lifecycle.
suggestion: Compile the literal pattern once before the loop or define it as a module-level constant.
limitations: Only direct re.compile calls with a string or bytes literal in an indented loop body or while condition are reported.
Imported aliases, multiline calls, single-line for suites, and dynamically computed patterns are not inferred.
